definition: RTX Video Super Resolution (RTX VSR) is a video scaling feature by Nvidia.
story: Imagine explaining a hard concept to a friend using nothing but a napkin and a pen. A small key that opens a much bigger door. Behind the jargon is an idea you could explain to a friend over coffee. A small mental model that makes a big tangle suddenly simple. That is Video Super Resolution — a small key that opens a big door.
